method: Four-source weight/freshness blend minus Original Ervin correction; independent races do not transfer D/R error

ME.source: Ervin's Take · recent publisher blend (7-day limit)
ME.note: Model-based statewide margin from recent attributed publisher averages, not a county poll.

MI.source: Ervin's Take · publisher blend + original history + discounted candidate context
MI.note: Ervin’s Take: Original Michigan Senate historical correction plus an unvalidated, heavily discounted candidate-primary error context; not a religious/poll-mode penalty.

candidateStrength.label: Ervin's Take candidate-strength marker
candidateStrength.earlierContest: Michigan 2026 Democratic U.S. Senate primary, August 4
candidateStrength.rationale: Transfers only 20% of the primary polling overstatement to the general-election forecast as a judgmental, candidate-specific weakness marker. A primary is not comparable to the general electorate, and the primary included a withdrawn candidate. It is not a validated religion-related Bradley effect and is not historical statewide Senate error.
